name: Replika
summary: Long-running 3D-avatar AI companion featuring voice calls, AR mode, and emotional coaching, tempered by restrictive relationship paywalls and legacy filter shifts.
ranking_rationale: Wins on polished 3D avatar presentation, voice calling, and memory continuity for everyday companionship, though adult ERP rules and pricey tiers lag purpose-built NSFW apps.

pricing.free_tier: Limited friend-mode text chat free; relationship modes paywalled
pricing.notes: In-app subscription pricing varies across Web, iOS, and Android.

pros: Polished customizable 3D avatar with room decor and voice/AR calls
Structured diary entries and long-term emotional memory features
Dedicated native apps on iOS, Android, and Meta Quest VR
cons: Romantic partner/adult features gated behind expensive annual Pro/Ultra tiers
History of sudden safety-filter rollbacks eroded long-time user trust
Scripted therapy-speak surfaces frequently under suggestive prompts

facts.value: Web, iOS, Android, plus dedicated Meta Quest VR client
